source_caption_text:
#YellaBeezy Found Guilty Of #Mo3’s M**der Exactly 6 Years After Mo3 Was K***ed, On The Same Date 😳👀

Yella Beezy, Born Markies Deandre Conway, Is A Dallas, Texas Rapper Who Rose To Fame With His Breakout Hit “That’s On Me.” He Became One Of The Most Recognizable Names In The Dallas Rap Scene, Building A Major Following With His Southern Rap Sound And Tracks Like “Bacc At It Again” And “Up One.”

MO3, Born Melvin Abdul Noble Jr., Was A Dallas, Texas Rapper Known For His Emotional Storytelling, Melodic Flow, And Raw Street-Inspired Music. He Built A Loyal Fanbase With Songs Like “Everybody,” “Outside,” And “Broken Love” Featuring Kevin Gates. MO3 Tragically Lost His Life In November 2020 After Being Sh*t And K*lled On A Dallas Highway At Just 28 Years Old. His Music Continues To Have A Major Impact On The Dallas Rap Scene.

Latest Update — November 11, 2026

Yella Beezy Has Officially Been Found **GUILTY Of Capital M*rder** In Connection With MO3’s 2020 D*ath. Prosecutors Accused Him Of Arranging A M*rder-For-Hire Plot Against The Fellow Dallas Rapper Following A Long-Running Feud.

The Verdict Comes Exactly Six Years After MO3 Was K*lled On November 11, 2020. Kewon White, The Man Convicted Of Carrying Out The Sh**ting, Was Previously Sentenced To Life In Prison. The Case Has Been One Of The Most Talked-About Legal Battles In Dallas Hip-Hop History. CBS News
